snp1.3:1.1:
Renouncing violence
for all living beings,
snp1.3:1.2: harming not even one of them,
snp1.3:1.3:
you would not wish for offspring,
so how a companion?
snp1.3:2.1:
For a person by nature entangled
there are affections;
snp1.3:2.2: on the heels of affection, this pain.
snp1.3:2.3: Seeing the drawback born of affection,
snp1.3:5.1:
As a deer in the wilds,
unfettered,
snp1.3:5.2: goes for forage wherever it wants:
snp1.3:6.1:
In the midst of companions
—when staying at home,
snp1.3:6.2:
when going out wandering—
you are prey to requests.
snp1.3:6.3:
Valuing the freedom
that no one else covets,
snp1.3:7.1:
There is sporting & love
in the midst of companions,
snp1.3:8.1: Without resistance in all four directions,
snp1.3:9.1:
They are hard to please,
some of those gone forth,
snp1.3:9.2: as well as those living the household life.
snp1.3:9.3:
Being unconcerned
with the offspring of others,
snp1.3:10.2:
like a kovilara tree
that has shed its leaves,
snp1.3:10.3: the enlightened one, cutting all household ties,
snp1.3:11.1: If you gain an astute companion,
snp1.3:12.1: If you don’t gain an astute companion,
snp1.3:12.3:
wander alone
like a king renouncing his kingdom,
snp1.3:12.4:
like the elephant in the Mataṅga wilds,
[his herd].
snp1.3:13.2:
Those on a par, or better,
should be chosen as friends.
snp1.3:13.3:
If they’re not to be found,
living faultlessly,
snp1.3:14.1:
Seeing radiant bracelets of gold,
well-made by a smith,
snp1.3:14.2:
clinking, clashing,
two on an arm,
snp1.3:15.2: there would be conversation or attachment.”
snp1.3:16.1:
Because sensual pleasures,
elegant, honeyed, & charming,
snp1.3:16.2: bewitch the mind with their manifold forms—
snp1.3:16.3: seeing this drawback in sensual strings—
snp1.3:17.2: disease, an arrow, a danger for me.”
snp1.3:17.3: Seeing this danger in sensual strings,
snp1.3:19.1:
As a great white elephant,
with massive shoulders,
snp1.3:19.3: lives in the wilds wherever he wants,
snp1.3:20.1:
“There’s no way
that one delighting in company
snp1.3:20.3:
Heeding the words
of the Kinsman of the Sun,
snp1.3:21.2:
the sure way attained,
the path gained,
snp1.3:21.3:
[realizing:]
“Unled by others,
I have knowledge arisen,”
snp1.3:22.1:
With no greed, no deceit,
no thirst, no hypocrisy—
snp1.3:22.3:
with no inclinations for all the world,
every world,
snp1.3:23.2:
disregarding the goal,
intent on the discordant way.
snp1.3:23.3:
Don’t associate yourself
with someone heedless & hankering.
snp1.3:24.1:
Consort with one who is learned,
who maintains the Dhamma,
snp1.3:24.3:
Knowing the meanings,
subdue your perplexity,
snp1.3:25.1:
Free from longing, finding no pleasure
in the world’s sport, ardor,
snp1.3:25.3:
abstaining from adornment,
speaking the truth,
snp1.3:27.1:
“This is a bondage.
There’s little happiness here,
snp1.3:27.2:
next to no enjoyment,
all the more suffering & pain.
snp1.3:27.3:
This is a boil”:
Knowing this, circumspect,
snp1.3:28.2: like a fish in the water tearing a net,
snp1.3:28.3: like a fire not coming back to what’s burnt,
snp1.3:30.2:
like a coral tree
that has shed its leaves,
snp1.3:30.3: going forth in the ochre robe,
snp1.3:31.1: Showing no greed for flavors, not wanton,
snp1.3:31.2: going from house to house for alms
snp1.3:31.3: with mind unenmeshed in this family or that,
snp1.3:33.1: Turning your back on pleasure & pain,
snp1.3:34.1:
With persistence aroused
for the highest goal’s attainment,
snp1.3:34.2: with mind unsmeared, not lazy in action,
snp1.3:34.3: firm in effort, with steadfastness & strength arisen,
snp1.3:35.2:
constantly living the Dhamma
in line with the Dhamma,
snp1.3:35.3:
comprehending the danger
in states of becoming,
snp1.3:36.1: Intent on the ending of craving
snp1.3:36.2:
& heedful,
neither drooling nor dumb,
but learned, mindful,
snp1.3:37.1: Unstartled, like a lion at sounds.
snp1.3:37.2: Unsnared, like the wind in a net.
snp1.3:37.3: Unsmeared, like a lotus in water:
snp1.3:38.1: Like a lion—forceful, strong in fang,
snp1.3:38.2: living as a conqueror, the king of beasts—
snp1.3:39.1:
At the right time consorting
with the release through
snp1.3:39.3:
unobstructed by all the world,
any world,
snp1.3:40.3: unfazed at the ending of life,
snp1.3:41.1:
People follow & associate
for a motive.
snp1.3:41.2:
Friends without a motive these days
are rare.
snp1.3:41.3: They’re shrewd for their own ends, & impure.
